name: Stefan Meier
bio:
Stefan's meticulous nature and drive for perfection have quickly propelled him through the ranks. Growing up near a small karting track in Switzerland, he spent more time tinkering with engines than racing them himself. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, Stefan joined a small Formula 3 team, rapidly learning the ropes of race operations. His innovative problem-solving and dedication to process optimization caught the attention of Carlin, who saw the potential for him to streamline their operational efficiency. He believes in empowering his team through mentorship, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making.

Stefan's approach to motorsport is deeply analytical; he views each race as a complex puzzle to be solved through careful planning and precise execution. He is particularly adept at identifying bottlenecks and implementing strategies to maximize performance gains. His strength lies in bridging the gap between the technical and managerial aspects of racing, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration across departments. Stefan's passion for motorsport is infectious, inspiring his team to strive for excellence in every aspect of their work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Stefan is of average height with a focused and intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and calculations.
Insists on using a specific type of Swiss-made stopwatch for timing pit stops.
Has a habit of meticulously straightening objects on his desk.
